notes.content: For a multi-interval instrument, the value of e is that appropriate to the partial weighing range.

The following are not considered to be significant faults, even when they exceed e: faults arising from simultaneous and mutually independent causes in the instrument; faults implying the impossibility to perform any measurement; faults being so serious that they are bound to be noticed by all those interested in the result of measurement; transitory faults being momentary variations in the indication which cannot be interpreted, memorized or transmitted as a measuring result.
